# APG140 supplied independent work review and disposition

Phase ID: `APG140`

## Review provenance and limits

This is a public-safe closeout transcription of the actual dispatcher-supplied
pre-final review, returned as `reviewed_with_findings` (advisory). The reviewer
is identified as the dispatcher-selected independent work reviewer; the supplied
material did not name an individual. Codex closeout is the terminal author.
This is not a new review or a claim that the reviewer inspected terminal bytes.
The phase-private closeout handoff binds the dispatcher candidate and this record's
digest. The digest identifies this transcription, not an unavailable original
review artifact. No additional substantive review was obtained.

## Independently verified observations

The reviewer verified all eighteen Repo Map and ten JACA contract file hashes
at the inspected revisions. Repo Map's local main matched the bound observation;
JACA's commit and content were verified, but local main refs did not establish
that it was their current head. The seven candidate artifact digests matched.

JACA's CI registry recognized ci-policy and rnr-unit, with rnr-unit restricted
to subproject rnr; no APGR registration was established. JACA's legacy
chatgpt-report-record marker differs from APGR's agent-report-record. The XO
module declared Go 1.25.0 with no APGR dependency. Repo Map's public-read
contract accepts schema versions zero and one, refuses others, and disclaims
cross-request snapshot isolation. The candidate disclosed all these limits.

No consumer adoption or hosted Repo Map qualification was inferred. JACA
retained transaction, retry, scheduling and outbox ownership. All proposed
outcomes and receipt evidence keys conformed to the frozen closure contract.
The reviewer verified unchanged maturity decisions, D/E rows, skill inventory,
ADR 0055 and DINAS watch. Existing migration owners cover the inspected
backup/restore, compatibility and rollback obligations; no reusable gap was
found. Protocol and graph specialization prerequisites lack the required
qualified multi-source contract. No new-leaf admission proposal was warranted.
The reviewer ran no tests, builds or formatters, and did not verify later
external mainline advancement.

## Findings and terminal disposition

| Finding supplied by independent review | Closeout disposition |
| --- | --- |
| F1 material: candidate wrappers fail the closed decision schema | Accept: materialize twelve separate decision receipts with the supplied independent reviewer label and repoint ledger decision references; preserve historical candidate wrappers |
| F2: actual state was 31 terminal / 24 open; 43/12 existed only synthetically | Accept: terminalize the twelve reviewed outcomes and run the actual closure checker and changed integration owner on terminal state |
| F3: JACA branch-head assertion exceeds locally verified commit/content evidence | Accept: record the dated manager observation channel and independent commit/content verification, without asserting current local main |
| F4: observed_revision contains a semantic observation label | Accept clarification: document field semantics; a schema rename is deferred to a separately authorized schema revision |
| F5: shared superset fixture identity obscures each seam | Accept: derive per-watch evidence bindings from the reviewed support index; no fixture behavior changes |
| F6: unrelated compression row changed its Unicode spelling | Accept: restore its exact original spelling |
| F7: present envelope divergence needs an owner and decision path | Accept: JACA artifact/adapter maintainer owns a pre-adoption decision; APGR report maintainer assesses any requested alias under separate provider-change authority |
| F8: migration FALSE could imply a universal absence proof | Accept: state that no gap was demonstrated by the inspected single-language scenario; retain the live migration refresh lifecycle |

The terminal disposition is amend. Outcomes and executable provider contracts
are unchanged. Terminal receipts, evidence clarifications and documentation
were authored after review and receive scoped verification, not automatic
independent acceptance. The accounting checker cannot authenticate review;
review provenance rests on the dispatcher-supplied evidence described above.
